vellium.heroTitle: Tsare-tsaren Software Mai Dorewa da Madaidaici
vellium.heroSubtitle: Software da aka siffata ta daidaici, keɓantawa, da dogaro na dogon lokaci.
vellium.manifestoP1: Velliumyana gina tsarin software mai ɗorewa da siffa ta daidaici, keɓantawa, da dogaro na dogon lokaci.
vellium.manifestoP2: Muna ƙirƙirar samfuran software waɗanda ke haɗawa ta zahiri cikin ayyukan yau da kullun, rage juzu'in dijital, da ci gaba da sadar da ingantaccen ƙwarewar mai amfani akan lokaci. Ayyukanmu sun haɗa da kayan aikin tebur, tsarin sarrafa masana'antu, wuraren aiki na karatu mai hankali, amintattun dandamali na kasuwanci, kayan aikin kyamara, aikace-aikacen kwaikwaiyo, da al'ummomin dijital masu tasowa.
vellium.manifestoP3: Kowane samfurin da muka gina yana bin ƙa'ida ɗaya: software bai kamata ya ji rauni, hayaniya, ko abin zubarwa ba. Ya kamata ya ji kwanciyar hankali, ganganci, da mutunta hankalin mai amfani, bayanai, da mahalli.
vellium.manifestoP4: Daga gine-ginen gida-farko da haɗe-haɗe na tebur na asali zuwa sarrafa sirrin sirri, amintattun tsarin gudanarwa, ingantaccen algorithmic, kwaikwaiyon da ke goyan bayan koyan na'ura, da fasalin AI mai sarrafa mai amfani,Velliumyana fuskantar software a matsayin injiniyan sarari ta'aziyya - ba mahaɗar ɗan lokaci ba.
vellium.manifestoP5: Muna gina tsarin da ke rage hargitsi, adana sarrafawa, da kuma juya fasaha zuwa wani abu daidai, abin dogaro, kuma mai dorewa.
vellium.principle1Desc: Bayanan ku na ku ne. Yana aiki a layi da rufaffen gida.
vellium.principle2Desc: Babu amo, babban aiki, da kwanciyar hankali na dogon lokaci.
vellium.principle3Desc: Software ba abu ne na wucin gadi ba, amma sararin jin daɗin injiniyan injiniya.

docs.title: Takaddun bayanai
docs.subtitle: Duk abin da kuke buƙatar aikiEnv Vaulttare da amincewa.
docs.noResults: Babu wani ɓangaren takaddun da ya dace da bincikenku.
docs.quickStartDesc: Daga rumbun wofi zuwa fayil ɗin mahalli na farko da aka rufaffen.

docs.quickStartStep4: Fitar da fayil ɗin baya zuwa faifai a duk lokacin da aikin ke buƙata.
docs.securityDesc: Yadda ake kare bayanan ku akan faifai da a ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya.
docs.securityStep1: An shimfiɗa kalmar sirrin ku daArgon2idkuma ba a adana.
docs.securityStep2: Duk wani nau'in rubutu yana amfani da shiAES-256-GCMtare da sabo nonce.
docs.securityStep3: Ana ɓoye sirrin a cikin ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya lokacin da vault ya kulle ko app ɗin ya fita.
docs.importExportDesc: Matsar da fayilolin mahalli ciki da fita daga cikin rumbun cikin aminci.
docs.importExportStep1: Shigo da tsari yana karɓar duka manyan fayiloli kuma yana adana sunayen fayil na asali.

docs.importExportStep3: Fitarwa suna rubuta fayilolin UTF-8 tare da ƙarshen layin asali.
docs.backupDesc: Ajiye kwafin rufaffiyar samuwa bayan an sake shigarwa ko gazawar hardware.
docs.backupStep1: Ƙirƙiri kalmar sirri mai kariya.vaultbakrumbun adana bayanai daga Saituna.
docs.backupStep2: HaɗaOneDrive,Google Drive,Dropboxko kowane babban fayil don daidaitawa ta atomatik.
docs.backupStep3: Babban fayil ɗin girgije yana adana hoton na yanzu, na baya da 15 na yau da kullun.
docs.shortcutsDesc: Yi aiki ba tare da barin madannai ba.
docs.faq1Q: Me zai faru idan na manta kalmar sirri na?
docs.faq1A: Ba za a iya ɓoye ɓoyayyiyar rumbun ajiya ba tare da shi ba. Ajiye wariyar kalmar sirri da adana kalmar sirri lafiya.
docs.faq2A: A'a. Aikace-aikacen yana aiki ba layi ba kuma daidaitawar gajimare yana kwafin ɓoyayyen fayil ɗin vault ne kawai.
docs.faq3Q: Zan iya amfani da vault iri ɗaya akan wata kwamfuta?
docs.faq3A: Ee. Nuna aiki tare da gajimare a babban fayil guda kuma a mayar da shi daga hoton da aka ɓoye.
docs.faq4Q: Ana iya dawo da ayyukan da aka goge?
docs.faq4A: Kawai daga madadin. Goge a cikin rumbun ajiya na dindindin.
